document:3:183:0.text:
Ingredients:
<style="highlight">Sturdy Dashroot</style>
<style="highlight">Baby Mushrooms</style>
<style="highlight">Fresh Dew</style>
Mash the baby fuzzy mushrooms to extract the juice, grind <style="highlight">sturdy dashroot</style> into a fine powder, and add fresh dew. Simmer the mixture until small bubbles start to form on the surface.
document:3:183:0.source_cn:
配料：
<style="highlight">茁壮的疾根草</style>
<style="highlight">稚嫩的茸茸伞菇</style>
<style="highlight">新鲜的露水</style>
将稚嫩的茸茸伞菇捣成汁液，将<style="highlight">茁壮的疾根草</style>研磨成颗粒极小的粉末，再加入新鲜露水熬煮至表面冒出细小泡沫。
